caption: The drawing is a black and white line illustration that features a detailed design of a cast iron balcony railing. The railing is composed of repeating vertical panels, each featuring a symmetrical arrangement of decorative scrolls, circles, and oval-shaped loops interwoven with geometric elements such as rectangles and squares. The top and bottom rails are straight and horizontal, with the vertical supports dividing the decorative sections. The left side of the image includes dimension indicators, showing the height of the railing as "32 inches." The railing is attached to a building structure, with lines suggesting siding on the wall behind and below it. The lower part of the image contains the label "CAST IRON BALCONY RAILING" written in capital letters. The entire composition is monochrome, rendered in black ink on a cream or off-white paper background.
title: Cast Iron Balcony Railing
